add.name: HighlightsModule
add.description: Pure extraction module: per-category keyword dictionaries (food-dining, professional-services, personal-services), word-boundary match scoring, review-phrase mining, and result shaping into a deduped string[] (max 5, each max 80 chars). No I/O; fully unit-testable. Lives next to enrichment.rs in bw-scraper.

add.name: HighlightChips
add.description: Renders up to 3 highlight chips on directory cards and up to 5 on the detail page (existing Badge primitive, variant=default size=sm), plus a 'Customers say' pull-quote from the highest-rated stored review with reviewer name and location label. Hidden entirely when highlights are null or no reviews exist.

add.name: Highlights
add.description: businesses.highlights JSONB column: array of short highlight phrases (<=5 entries, each <=80 chars, deduped). null = never extracted. JSONB chosen over string[] so v2 facet pairs ({facet, value}) do not need a column change.
